fusions.name: Unflagging Strokes
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Trampled Footings
fusions.desc: Tramples through the footings ahead of you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles in front, knocking them back 3 tiles and leaving them [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hauling Team
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage and fights with 1 more power for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Haul
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you restore 20 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.
